{{StoryArc|Revenge of the King|TBA|Legends of Cybertron}}
[[File:Rise of Kolkular menu.jpg|thumb|250x250px]]
'''Rise of Kolkular''' is the third Legends of Cybertron mission introduced February 14, 2020.

==Intro == 

*'''[[Marissa Faireborn]]:''' Commander, there's Space Bridge activity but it's... strange. It's causing dark skies, bad weather, and it's raining SCRAP!
*'''[[Thundercracker]]:''' Yes, it seems someone has brought THE THUNDER! I've found a way to make something worthwhile in this wasteland.
*'''Marissa Faireborn:''' The bridge is unstable Thundercracker, No one will be able to pass through it.
*'''Thundercracker:''' I'm not looking for friends, I'm looking for POWER! I'm brining a bit of home here, Behold KOIKULAR!
*'''Marissa Faireborn:''' Commander, Teletraan confirms that pieces of the Decepticon Command have begun raining down upon New Quintessa.
*'''Thundercracker:''' Ancient power, magnificent corruption, and true doom shall come with it. None shall challenge the reign of Thundercrakcer!
*'''Marissa Faireborn:''' Commander, you should probably...challenge that reign. Be careful though, it looks like power levels in the area have been increased!

=== End ===

* '''Thundercracker:''' Pathetic beast. Formed of meat and shackled by gravity. You dare to call yourself COMMANDER?
* I have found the Cradle of the Decepticons. I have absorbed power and become stronger than you have ever known me to be.
* I shall scatter your ashes to the winds. Then at least you ghost will know the glory of residing in the sky!

==Bots ==
''"Commanders, Thundercracker has harnessed a Space Bridge to summon the power of the Decepticon Command Capitol, Kolkular, Take your best duo of Bots to face off against the strongest enemies yet! There are also 7 unique lanes of enemies to fight, with 6 of the lanes requiring specific Classes."''

All bots on this mission have no mods, just Special 3 unlocked. Like arena fights but harder as they have around 1 million plus health.

You can only bring in 2 bots and there are 6 class gates to access.

[[Thundercracker]] is at the end point of the mission.

====Free for All Path: ==== 
#Mirage
#Bludgeon
#Megatronus
#Bumblebee (DOTM)
#Windblade

====Brawler Path:====
# Ultra Magnus
#Grindor
#Kickback
#Wheeljack
#Optimus Prime (MV1)

====Warrior Path:====
#Optimus Primal
# Scorponok
#Megatron (ROTF)
#Blaster
#Motormaster

====Scout Path: ==== 
#Bonecrusher
#Starscream
#Barricade
#Waspinator
#Arcee

====Tech Path:====
#Prowl
#Mixmaster
#Soundwave
#Tantrum
# Bumblebee

====Demo Path:====
#Jetfire
#Cheetor
#Hot Rod
#Ramjet
#Shockwave

====Tactician Path:====
#Galvatron
#Sideswipe
#Rhinox
#Jazz
#Ironhide

==Rewards==

*Completion Rewards: 100,000 Titan Fragments, 10,000 5-Star Bot Crystal Shards, 3 Tier 4 Basic Sparks, 2 Tier 4 Class Spark Crystals, 1 Generic 5-Star Signature Awakening Program, 1,000,000 Gold
*Exploration Rewards: 200,000 Titan Fragments, 20,000 5-Star Bot Crystal Shards, 6 Tier 4 Basic Sparks, 2 Tier 4 Class Spark Crystals, 4 Tier 3 Alpha Sparks, 1 Generic 5-Star Signature Awakening Program, 2,000,000 Gold
